title: XDecideBench: Evaluating Typed Decision Models and Confidence Policies Across Languages
abstract: arXiv:2611.01370v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Applications use Typed Decision Models to route and moderate text in many languages, and they often act only on decisions above a confidence threshold. We introduce XDecideBench, a benchmark of nine suites in 122 languages with 88,425 texts and 153,875 typed questions. All suites share one scoring contract, and we report aligned, locally labelled and native items separately. Model rankings change from suite to suite. The model that is best in English, chosen in hindsight, loses significantly in about a quarter of the suite-language cells, and on Burmese Belebele it falls far behind the best model. Three open models fine-tuned for typed decisions beat the Qwen models they were built from in all twelve development languages. When the Qwen models are run locally, a pre-registered held-out cohort confirms that the accuracy gain is larger in the four languages with the least web text than in the six with the most. translated_title: XDecideBench：跨语言评估类型化决策模型与置信度策略
translated_abstract: 应用程序使用类型化决策模型对多种语言的文本进行路由与审核，且通常只对置信度超过阈值的决策采取行动。我们提出XDecideBench，这是一个涵盖122种语言、9个测试套件的基准，包含88,425篇文本和153,875个类型化问题。所有套件共享统一的评分契约，我们分别报告对齐项、本地标注项和母语原生项。模型排名随套件而变化。事后选出的英语最优模型在约四分之一的套件-语言组合中显著落败，并且在缅甸语Belebele上远落后于最佳模型。三个针对类型化决策微调的开源模型，在其所基于的Qwen模型的全部十二个开发语言中均胜出。当Qwen模型在本地运行时，一个预先注册的留出验证队列证实，在网络文本最少的四种语言中的准确率提升大于在网络文本最多的六种语言中。在这两组语言中……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出XDecideBench，一个覆盖122种语言的大规模基准，用于评估类型化决策模型与置信度策略，揭示了模型排名随语言和套件显著变化，且针对类型化决策微调的开源模型在网络文本较少的低资源语言中带来更大的准确率提升。
en_tdlr: XDecideBench is a large-scale benchmark spanning 122 languages for evaluating typed decision models and confidence policies, revealing that model rankings shift significantly across suites and languages, and that open models fine-tuned for typed decisions yield larger accuracy gains in languages with the least web text.
